Ida Vind is a medical professional serving as a chief physician (*overlæge*) and clinical lecturer (*klinisk lektor*) for the Capital Region of Denmark (Region Hovedstaden) [^src1]. Holding a Ph.D., she is a member of the steering committee for the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] (DANIBD) [^src1]. Her position on the committee reflects her dual role as both a practicing clinician and an education lead within the field of gastroenterology [^src1].

As part of the DANIBD steering committee, Vind contributes to the strategic governance of Denmark's national registry for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) [^src1]. The committee acts as the strategic steering unit overseeing cross-regional quality measurements, standardized coding, and the development of evidence-based treatment guidelines [^src1]. This includes evaluating clinical benchmarks and quality indicators—such as patient education and the administration of biologics or small molecules—based on national data, such as the metrics tracked in the 2023 annual report covering the period from October 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023 [^src1].
